title: Damage Allowance Amount on Deposit-Program Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
**Determination.** The damage allowance on an order in a Ridgeline Special Order Services program whose deposit at order is 50 percent is the program's damage allowance percentage of the order total billed on the order, rounded to the nearest cent.

## Terms used

- **The order total billed** is the amount of the order billing line on the order; fees and credits on the order do not enter it.
- **The program's damage allowance percentage** is the figure of the order's program in the Ridgeline Special Order Services damage report and allowance table.
- **Rounding.** The allowance is the order total billed multiplied by the percentage divided by 100, rounded once to the nearest cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical orders)

| Program percentage | Order total billed | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | 1800.00 | 270.00 |
| 15 | 2418.60 | 362.79 |
| 0 | 2600.00 | 0.00 |

## Basis questions

**Does a home delivery fee on the order raise the allowance?** No. The allowance is figured on the order total billed only.
